verdict.rationale: Treasury Prime is an API-first banking platform: API-key auth, an `account` endpoint listing accounts, statement generation and retrieval for documents, and status tracking on ACH, wire and card-event objects that covers in-flight activity. Registrable webhooks and an llms.txt add agent-friendly access, so an agent can read the banking picture without scraping a dashboard. Missing for 10: an explicitly evidenced transaction-history/ledger endpoint, explicit pending-vs-posted balance data, a first-party MCP server, a discoverable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration.
